# Welcome

Hi, I am H. This is where I keep my notes as I study mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, and network engineering. I write them to make sense of things for myself, and I put them online in case they help you too.

## What You Find Here

- **Mathematics**: Linear algebra, calculus, and probability theory for network analysis
- **Machine Learning**: Supervised learning and advanced learning algorithms, including neural networks and multiclass classification
- **Deep Learning**: Neural network architectures and training techniques
- **Network Engineering**: CCIE-level documentation and real-world implementations
- **Research**: Graduate-level work on network optimization and machine learning
- **Code and Tools**: Scripts and utilities for network automation

```{=html}
<p id="last-commit" style="margin-top: 3rem; font-size: 0.8em; color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #6c757d); text-align: center;"></p>
<script>
fetch("https://api.github.com/repos/hosseinoliabak/h/commits?per_page=1")
  .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(); })
  .then(function (commits) {
    var c = commits[0];
    var when = new Date(c.commit.committer.date).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit"
    });
    document.getElementById("last-commit").innerHTML =
      'Last updated: <a href="' + c.html_url + '" style="color: inherit;">' + when + "</a>";
  })
  .catch(function () {});
</script>
```
